description: Stop a running session with a summary and outcome. Pass session_id from get_now; without it, only this connection's single running session is stopped, never another one. The timer keeps running for other sessions. outcome=done completes the linked plan item or path step. Without end_at or op_id it refuses a session that already ended: use edit_session for that. With end_at (apps delivering a stop queued offline) a second stop on the same session is merged, whatever order they arrive in: the earliest end wins, done wins over any other outcome, the first summary stays and a different later one goes to the notes; the answer says applied: ended | shortened | recorded.

end_at.description: when the work ended as ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. 2026-10-20T14:05:00+02:00. For apps delivering a request queued offline; an agent calling interactively leaves it out. Rejected before the session start; a clock more than 2 minutes ahead of the server is taken as now

op_id.description: for apps replaying queued requests: an id the app minted before its first attempt and reuses on retries, so the write is applied once and a retry gets the first answer back. Do not invent one; an agent calling interactively leaves it out

session_id.description: from get_now; required with op_id or end_at

name: stop_session
title: Stop session
